about.title: About Hyundai Bio

ceo.title: CEO Message
body: Hyundai Bio is a company that values not only the outer beauty of humanity, but also the inner beauty of health.
With this philosophy, we develop safe and superior products, aspiring to become a world-class global leader in Medical Beauty.

Backed by proven efficacy and safety through extensive clinical trials, Hyundai Bio will continue expanding into advanced and emerging markets, while driving meaningful results through increased R&D investment.
JD Bio will promote the excellence of K-Beauty while growing into a company that shapes the global market. Our entire team is committed to meeting the expectations of those who generously support us.

visionMission.headline: Transforming Beauty, Empowering Lives
visionMission.body: Hyundai Bio leads the global medical beauty industry by harmonizing outer elegance with inner vitality. We are shaping the future of holistic beauty through continuous innovation and growth.
visionMission.mission: "To build a next-generation medical beauty ecosystem that harmonizes physical elegance with inner vitality."

about.networkHeading: Reaching Global Markets Through Our Worldwide Network
about.networkDescription: Hyundai Bio's products and partners span the globe. We work with trusted distributors, clinics, and retailers to bring bio-aesthetic solutions to consumers worldwide.
